arguments.prompt: Point of view from the Mayor's office window, looking down between two giant limestone columns at a long timber rally stage under construction in the square below. The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move at all: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time speed, natural human movement, never slow motion. Six workmen in high-visibility vests move at a normal working pace around the platform, two carrying a board together, one kneeling to fix decking; the two tall braced uprights stand still. Beyond the stage the square goes about its morning: parked cars do not move, the lumber truck and open box van stand still, a bus is stopped at the far corner, a few pedestrians walk slowly at a distance with their backs to us, a cyclist rolls by. Flat winter daylight, a faint reflection of the room on the glass. Prestige political drama photographed on an Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses: single-source natural light, slight 35mm film grain, colours desaturated about twelve percent, warm tungstens, deep browns and charcoals in the shadows, photographic realism.
